architecture.mechanism: Early detection of engine degradation through oil analysis to prevent catastrophic failure.
architecture.intervention: Implement real-time kinematic viscosity and oxidation monitoring sensors in the turbocharger lubrication circuit to trigger an engine safe-mode shutdown before seal failure allows oil ingress into the exhaust.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevention of oil leakage into the exhaust system by identifying lubricant breakdown and component wear prior to seal compromise during highway operation.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate a test turbocharger unit under accelerated degradation conditions; if the sensor system fails to detect viscosity changes or oxidation levels correlating with impending seal failure before oil appears in the exhaust trace, the mechanism is invalid.
